pricing_text: Billing is calculated per second of video generated. Rates **without audio / with audio** are **360p: $0.025 / $0.035**; **540p: $0.035 / $0.045**; **720p: $0.045 / $0.060**; **1080p: $0.090 / $0.115**. For example, a **5-second video at 720p** costs **$0.225 without audio** or **$0.300 with audio**.
notes: by_resolution بدون صوت (generate_audio_switch الافتراضي false). مع الصوت: 360p $0.035، 540p $0.045، 720p $0.060، 1080p $0.115 — الزيادة $0.01 لـ360p/540p و$0.015 لـ720p و$0.025 لـ1080p (audio_surcharge_usd = زيادة الدقة الافتراضية 720p). تنبيه: pricing_parsed في fal-launch.json وضع سعر 1080p = 0.06 خطأً؛ الصحيح 0.09. الافتراضي 720p. المدة 1–15 ثانية.
